change.desktopPatch: patches/desktop/0021-caret-agent-home-utility.patch - 4 new files under src/vs/sessions/contrib/home/browser/** plus one import line in src/vs/sessions/sessions.common.main.ts
change.utilityPane: New AgentHomeUtilityInput/AgentHomeUtilityEditor pair renders the reference's 2x2 card grid in the right column. Each card is a launcher for a command Caret already has: Changes -> workbench.action.agentSessions.newChangesTab, Browser -> workbench.action.agentSessions.newBrowserTab, Terminal -> workbench.action.terminal.toggleTerminal, File -> workbench.action.quickOpen. No embedded fake surface, no address bar, no textarea, no copied implementation.
change.noEditorChrome: AgentHomeUtilityEditor adds caret-agent-home-utility-active to the editor part while it owns the group, and the patch CSS drops .editor-group-container > .title for that state, so the tab strip, Add Tab and the close control are gone from the empty home. The input is a singleton with EditorInputCapabilities.CannotClose.
change.supersededBy: docs/maintenance/evidence/agent-home-apps-panel-2026-09-15/receipt.json - the caret-agent-home-utility-active class is gone; the current rule derives the same suppression from the panel's own DOM via :has() so it cannot go stale, and the panel now draws the pane's only strip (D1-D5 in the plan).
change.proportions: The contribution sets the sidebar to the parity contract's 255 logical px and the editor (utility) part to 22.5% of the window width at startup; the CSS narrows the composer card and the row above it to the reference's 608px, centred.
change.scoping: Everything is guarded by IsSessionsWindowContext and lives under src/vs/sessions/**, so the IDE window keeps its own layout, editor chrome and composer.

fixedVisibleDifferences: Blank right editor canvas replaced by the four-card utility grid.
Right column narrowed from ~40% of the window to 22.6%, matching the reference's 22.5%.
Composer narrowed to the reference's 608px and centred (was 800px, full column width).
Editor tab strip, Add Tab and the close control are no longer shown in the empty home.
remainingVisibleDifferences: Sidebar is still the base session tree: no full-width New Chat / Search / Automations / Customize rows, no Projects section, no Repositories section, no Getting Started card, no profile/settings rows, and the Customizations pane still renders as a detached footer.

Composer has the workspace picker and Customize chips only: no branch selector, no runtime chip beyond the session-type picker, no quick-action chips (Plan New Idea / Multitask / Run on This Mac) and no suggestion rows.
Titlebar still contains the 448x24 `Show Sessions` widget in the centre slot; the reference has no such control.
Left column is 255px by contract value (17.8% of a 1440-wide window) while the reference capture measures 15.6%; the two only agree at the reference viewport.
